# Imperfect Homelab

> A complete self-hosted homelab (media, photos, documents, a git forge, single sign-on, monitoring, phone alerts, 3-2-1 backups) installed from a public NixOS module library in one pass, then explained well enough to add to. A hat tip to Perfect Media Server.

If you are an agent helping someone install or extend this, read these in order:

- [For agents](https://ww4.github.io/imperfect-homelab/start-here/for-agents/): the headless contract — every command takes `--json`, exit codes, where secrets go, what to never do
- [The install skill](https://ww4.github.io/imperfect-homelab/skills/homelab-install/SKILL.md): the procedure, step by step, as an Agent Skill
- The booted installer serves a wizard at `http://<machine>:8099` with a JSON API (`/api/state`, `/api/action`, gated by a code on its console) — the skill above documents it; an agent can drive a whole install through it.
- [Quick start](https://ww4.github.io/imperfect-homelab/quick-start/): the beginner's path, click by click (Windows, Rufus, boot menu, the seven TUI screens, first login) — hand this to a person who has never used Linux
- [The installer ISO](https://ww4.github.io/imperfect-homelab/install/the-installer-iso/): download, checksum, write, boot
- [Cloudflare DNS and the API token](https://ww4.github.io/imperfect-homelab/accounts/cloudflare-dns/): the out-of-band work for TLS, step by step — getting the domain to Cloudflare, the scoped token, what each of the installer's verify messages means, and how to set the token after the install
- [A VPN account for the download client](https://ww4.github.io/imperfect-homelab/accounts/vpn/): the WireGuard values gluetun needs, per provider, and what a forwarded port changes
- [The configurator's README](https://github.com/ww4/homelab-modules/blob/main/configurator/README.md): commands, the answers file, what comes out
- [Services](https://ww4.github.io/imperfect-homelab/services/): every module, its options and secrets (generated from the library's catalog)

The whole site as one text file: [llms-full.txt](https://ww4.github.io/imperfect-homelab/llms-full.txt).

The question set is machine-readable: `nix run 'github:ww4/homelab-modules?dir=configurator' -- schema --json`.
